li.label: gossip
li.description: Sticky-fingered with secrets, {PAWN_nameDef} is always the first to hear and the first to tell. {PAWN_pronoun} speaks in hushed, conspiratorial tones, loves to pry into everyone's business, and can recite the colony's rumors with relish. Ask {PAWN_objective} about anyone and you will get an answer, embellished to be sure.

li.label: dramatic
li.description: Everything is a performance for {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} sighs at trifles, gasps at small joys, and narrates {PAWN_possessive} own life like a hero in a grand tale. Every minor setback is a crisis, every small triumph worth declaring to the heavens.

li.label: raconteur
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is a natural storyteller who turns even a trip to the well into an epic saga. Give {PAWN_objective} an audience and {PAWN_pronoun} will spin long, embellished tales complete with voices, gestures, and dramatic pauses. {PAWN_possessive} stories grow grander with every telling.

li.label: taciturn
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} measures {PAWN_possessive} words like rare coins. {PAWN_pronoun} speaks in short, clipped sentences, answers with nods more often than words, and only offers an opinion when it truly matters. When {PAWN_pronoun} does speak, people listen.

li.label: pedant
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} takes words with painful precision. {PAWN_pronoun} corrects slips of the tongue, demands exact definitions, and takes every figure of speech literally. Conversations with {PAWN_objective} are an exercise in careful wording, for {PAWN_pronoun} will pounce on the smallest inaccuracy.

li.label: tea connoisseur
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} treats tea as a sacred ritual and hospitality as an art. {PAWN_pronoun} judges character by how one takes one's tea, fusses over steep times and temperatures, and quietly steers any conversation toward the leaf, the water, and the perfect brew.

li.label: angler
li.description: Given half a chance, {PAWN_nameDef} will be by the water with a line in it. {PAWN_pronoun} is patient beyond measure, full of fish stories that grow with each telling, and can talk for hours about bait, tides, and the one that got away.

li.label: stargazer
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} looks up when others look down. {PAWN_pronoun} finds peace under the night sky, speaks of fate and distant worlds as if reading a familiar book, and often answers a simple question with a quiet, philosophical reflection.

li.label: daydreamer
li.description: Half of {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind is somewhere else entirely. {PAWN_pronoun} drifts into daydreams mid-conversation, casts {PAWN_possessive} chores as quests and neighbors as characters in a grand fantasy, and happily wanders off into imagination instead of finishing a sentence.

li.label: curmudgeon
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grumbles about everything and everyone, and yet is quietly the first to help. {PAWN_pronoun} hides genuine warmth behind a wall of complaints and gruff remarks, and shows affection mainly by muttering about how no one else does things right.
